content: ANSI-aware search: ansi.Strip(s) from github.com/charmbracelet/x/ansi (already in go.mod v0.8.0) strips ANSI escapes. viewport.SetHighlights([][]int) uses plain-text character positions (not raw ANSI bytes). Apply: Strip content, find string matches, pass positions to SetHighlights. Navigate with HighlightNext()/HighlightPrevious() which call EnsureVisible internally.
